description: **Deal With It** is a memory game where the cards refuse to sit still. Every table is dealt face up for a moment, then the cards flip down and start sliding across the felt, bouncing off the walls and off each other while you tap pairs. Clear the table and it deals one more pair than the last, so the challenge keeps growing until the clock runs out.
controls: Tap a card to flip it face up, then tap a second card to try for a pair. Matching pairs score and vanish; a miss shows both cards for a moment before they flip back and your streak resets. Tapping while the deal is still face up skips the peek and starts the clock. Taps only - no dragging, no pinching.
logic: Each match is worth a base score plus a streak bonus, so pairs found in a row are worth progressively more; a miss drops you back to the base. Clearing a table pays a bonus per pair and deals one more pair, up to what the table can hold. Your best score is saved between runs and shown under the live score - beat it and the score line flashes NEW BEST!. When the clock hits zero the cards turn face up one last time and the result screen shows how you did.
credits: Card art: Card Asset Pack by natomarcacini (CC0 1.0). Music and sound effects generated for this game. Built with the Defold engine (Defold License 1.0).
